title: 第十一章 遛胖子喽第十二章 比斗狂魔
content_zh:
训练大楼第二层，也有不少学员在训练。
王腾目光一扫，眼睛突然微亮，看到了一个熟悉的身影。
一个灵活的胖子！
此时正在跑道上狂奔。
对方竟然也升到了中级武徒，难怪昨天一整天都没有在一楼看到他，原来是来了二楼。
“胖子，早啊！”
王腾像是面对老熟人一般朝着对方打了声招呼。
胖子听到声音，转头看过来，脸色顿时就变了：“怎么是这个家伙！”
他装作没看到王腾，一句话也不回，跑的更快了。
王腾看着对方跑着跑着，完全不知道自己屁股后面正掉着属性气泡，心里直乐。
他施展基础身法，跟在胖子身后一边跑，一边拾取属性。
【速度*6】
【速度*7】
【基础身法*3】
【速度*6】
……
“提升到中级武徒，这胖子掉落的属性点更多了，这么说来，实力越高，掉落属性点越多。”
王腾心中暗忖。
如果真是这样，那么在二楼捡的属性肯定比一楼多！
毕竟这里都是中级武徒。

如此一来，相信用不了多久便能提升到高级武徒了，距离正式武者也更近了一步。
“你这家伙怎么像个狗皮膏药似得，老是粘着我？还有完没完了？”
前面胖子气愤的声音将王腾从思绪中拉了回来。
“嘿嘿，一个人训练有什么意思，不如我们来比比，跑十圈看谁用的时间少，怎么样？来不来？”
王腾道。
胖子正想拒绝，眼珠一转，说道：“如果你输了，就离我远点，让我一个人训练。”
“可以！”
王腾答应了下来，又道：“要是你输了呢？”
“笑话，我怎么可能会输！”
胖子不屑道。
“自信是好事，不过既然你提了条件，我自然也有要求，比试讲的就是一个公平性，你说对吧？”
王腾说
“那你想怎么样？”
胖子皱眉问道。
“很简单，如果你输了，当着大家的面唱一首《征服》，怎么样？”
王腾道。
“行，只要你能赢，唱什么都行，别说一首《征服》了，唱十首都没问题。”
胖子拍着胸口答应道。
王腾心中暗笑——十首？等下有你哭的时候。
“旁边有计时器，我去找个人帮我们计时。”
content_en:
There are also many students training on the second floor of the training building.
Wang Teng glanced around, his eyes suddenly brightened, and he saw a familiar figure.
A flexible fat man!
Currently running wildly on the track.
The other party has actually been promoted to an intermediate martial artist. No wonder I didn't see him on the first floor all day yesterday. It turned out that he was on the second floor.
"Fat man, morning!"
Wang Teng greeted him as if he were an old acquaintance.
When the fat man heard the sound, he turned his head and looked over, his expression suddenly changed: "Why is it this guy!"
He pretended not to see Wang Teng, didn't reply a word, and ran faster.
Wang Teng watched the other person running, completely unaware that attribute bubbles were falling from behind his butt, and felt very happy.
He used basic movement skills and ran behind the fat man while picking up attributes.
【Speed*6】
【Speed*7】
[Basic body skills*3]
【Speed*6】
…
"After being promoted to an intermediate warrior, this fat man will drop more attribute points. In other words, the higher the strength, the more attribute points he will drop."
Wang Teng thought to himself.
If this is the case, then there must be more properties picked up on the second floor than on the first floor!
After all, these are all intermediate martial arts disciples.
In this way, I believe that it won't be long before he can be promoted to a high-level warrior, and he will be one step closer to becoming a formal warrior.
"Why are you like a dog-skin plaster, always clinging to me? Is it over yet?"
The angry voice of the fat man in front pulled Wang Teng out of his thoughts.
"Hey, what's the point of training alone? How about we compete and run ten laps to see who takes less time? How about coming?"
Wang Teng said.
The fat man was about to refuse, but rolled his eyes and said, "If you lose, stay away from me and let me train alone."
"Okay!"
Wang Teng agreed and said, "What if you lose?"
"What a joke, how could I lose!"
The fat man said disdainfully.
"Confidence is a good thing, but since you have put forward conditions, I naturally have requirements too. The competition is all about fairness, right?"
Wang Teng said
"What do you want?"
The fat man asked with a frown.
"It's very simple. If you lose, how about singing "Conquer" in front of everyone?"
Wang Teng said.
"Okay, as long as you can win, you can sing anything. Forget just one song about "Conquer", it's okay to sing ten songs."
The fat man agreed, patting his chest.
Wang Teng secretly laughed in his heart - ten poems? Wait until you cry later.
"There's a timer next to it. I'll find someone to help us time it."
